nft.poolCapitalDetail: Current total value of deposit NFTs in the Vault.
nft.freeCapitalDetail: Shared by all deposits; individual withdrawal limits cannot be added together.
nft.lockedCapitalDetail: Net LP capital reserved until existing bets settle.
nft.pendingPrincipalDetail: Unsettled stakes held separately in the Bank.
nft.grossReserveDetail: Gross reserve for all open positions.
nft.bettingCapitalDetail: LP capital plus pending player principal; used by the betting risk limit.
nft.gameHoldDetail: Gaming revenue is not the return earned by an individual NFT.
nft.surplusDetail: Unexpected token transfers are not NFT capital and are not withdrawable here.
nft.riskTerms: At settlement, an earlier deposit range keeps both profit and loss only if its current capital covers that bet’s original maximum LP loss. Otherwise both are shared by the current pool, including later deposits. Zero-risk bets retain the empty-range fallback. Expected returns and risks follow this allocation; settlement order can change it. Withdrawn capital no longer participates. Issuer restrictions may prevent payment. If no LP capital remains, later profit goes to protocol capital.
nft.orderingRisk: Once its lock expires, available capital may be withdrawn before a bet's result is recorded on-chain. Capital that remains or arrives later may share gains or absorb losses from earlier bets. The 24-hour lock does not remove this transaction-ordering risk.
nft.depositTerms: Every deposit creates a separate NFT and starts its own 24-hour withdrawal lock. Capital participates in game results during this period. Transferring an NFT keeps its existing deadline.
nft.depositsPaused: Pool paused: new LP deposits are unavailable. Withdrawals stay open under the usual rules.
nft.withdrawTerms: Select a deposit NFT and a percentage of its current value. A successful withdrawal pays its current owner immediately. No withdrawal request or later claim is required.
nft.partialRelock: A partial withdrawal locks the remaining deposit for another 24 hours. A full withdrawal closes the NFT. The amount is an estimate; your transaction signs a percentage and is checked again against current chain state.
nft.sharedLimit: All NFTs share the pool’s available capital. Quotes may change as bets or other withdrawals execute; no full-payment deadline is guaranteed.
nft.unavailable: Current pool or deposit state is unavailable. Refresh before signing.
nft.empty: No deposit NFTs are owned by this wallet at this snapshot.
nft.approveVault: Approve the bound LiquidityVault to transfer these assets. No NFT or keeper approval is requested.
nft.ownerChanged: This wallet no longer owns the selected NFT. Refresh the deposit list.
nft.deposited: Deposit confirmed. A new NFT has its own 24-hour lock.
nft.withdrawn: Withdrawal confirmed. Refreshing the remaining capital.
nft.historyDetail: NFT transfers change ownership without transferring the underlying tokens. An NFT recipient’s return cannot be calculated without its acquisition cost. Payer, initial owner and withdrawal recipient are shown separately.
nft.historyEmpty: No deposit activity found in the loaded range.
nft.historyIncomplete: History is incomplete. Loaded entries do not establish a complete wallet return.
nft.noCashFlow: NFT transfer · no asset cash flow

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: These terms govern access to the ArbiGameFi frontend and the wallet-native interfaces used to reach rooms, bankroll pages, referral surfaces, and operational proof views.

highlights.0: The frontend is an interface for public on-chain systems.
highlights.1: Users remain responsible for wallet custody, transaction review, gas, and local compliance.
highlights.2: Availability can depend on RPC providers, indexers, oracle flows, wallets, and smart contracts.

0.title: Use of the frontend
0.body: The ArbiGameFi frontend presents wallet-native access to on-chain game rooms and bankroll surfaces. Access to the frontend does not remove the need to review transaction contents, quoted fees, network conditions, or the contracts being called before signing.

1.title: Wallets and execution
1.body: Users retain custody of their wallets and private keys. ArbiGameFi does not take custody of wallets, cannot recover private keys, and cannot reverse transactions that have been confirmed by the relevant network.

2.title: Protocol and room risk
2.body: Live rooms depend on smart contracts, randomness or oracle providers, indexers, RPC infrastructure, and third-party wallet providers. Service availability and outcome visibility may be affected by any of these layers.

3.title: No universal availability
3.body: The frontend may not be available in every jurisdiction, network condition, browser environment, or release channel. Users are responsible for determining whether access or participation is permitted where they are located.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: ArbiGameFi is built around public-chain execution. This policy explains the limited data the frontend may process in addition to wallet and transaction data already visible on-chain.

highlights.0: Wallet addresses and transaction hashes may be displayed when they are already public on-chain.
highlights.1: Product analytics and performance telemetry may be used to improve reliability and usability.
highlights.2: Wallet connectors, RPC providers, indexers, and oracle integrations may process request metadata.

0.title: Public blockchain data
0.body: Wallet addresses, transaction hashes, bet states, settlement outcomes, and bankroll activity may be rendered in public room feeds because they are already visible on-chain.

1.title: Frontend analytics
1.body: The frontend may collect product analytics, performance metrics, and engagement signals to improve room layouts, onboarding, operational visibility, and release quality.

2.title: Third-party services
2.body: Wallet connectors, RPC providers, indexers, analytics services, and oracle integrations may process request metadata as part of normal operation. Their own terms and privacy rules also apply.

3.title: Data minimization
3.body: The product should avoid collecting private keys, seed phrases, unnecessary personal identifiers, or raw wallet activity that is not required for product reliability, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.

disclaimer.title: Risk Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: ArbiGameFi presents interfaces for on-chain gaming and bankroll participation. Interacting with these systems involves financial, legal, and technical risks.

highlights.0: Smart contracts, randomness providers, indexers, RPC endpoints, and wallet clients can fail or lag.
highlights.1: Bankroll participation is subject to reserve usage, liability accounting, and protocol-specific exits.
highlights.2: Users are responsible for determining whether participation is lawful in their jurisdiction.

0.title: Protocol risk
0.body: Smart contract bugs, oracle disruptions, delayed finality, indexer lag, wallet client failures, or network congestion can affect the user experience or temporarily affect room visibility.

1.title: Market and liquidity risk
1.body: Bankroll participation is subject to reserve usage, liability accounting, and protocol-specific exit rules. Availability of deposits, withdrawals, and redemptions may change with room activity.

2.title: Outcome and settlement risk
2.body: Casino rooms depend on randomness. Settlement may be delayed when the randomness provider lags or network conditions prevent timely transaction confirmation.

3.title: Jurisdiction and compliance
3.body: Users must determine for themselves whether use of the frontend, room participation, or LP activity is lawful in their jurisdiction.

faq.description: Everything you need to start playing, verify a result, and stay in control.

0.question: Why is my bet still waiting?

contact.title: Still need help?
contact.description: Reach the team or check live system status.

items.a: Connect a wallet from the top-right menu, make sure you're on a supported network, and pick a game. Wins pay straight to your wallet — there's no signup, deposit account, or custody.

items.q: How do I get test funds on Base Sepolia?
items.a: Base Sepolia is a testnet. Get free test ETH from a Base Sepolia faucet for gas, then use a test USDC faucet for the play balance. Testnet funds have no real value.

The Bank is the on-chain vault that backs every payout. Before a bet is accepted, its maximum payout is reserved there, and you can inspect balances and reserves on the Pools page. Every win is paid from it.

House edge is the margin built into game payouts. In the current v1.6 design, LPs retain 50% of theoretical house edge calculated from used turnover; protocol fees and referral rewards share the other half. This is not a guaranteed LP return. The project has not launched. Each game shows its applicable rate in Game Info.

Bets settle using Chainlink VRF for provably fair randomness. After you place a bet, the contract requests a random number; once it arrives the round settles automatically. This usually takes a few seconds.

items.q: What if the random number never arrives?
items.a: If VRF is delayed past the timeout, you can refund your stake yourself — the refund button appears in the round status panel. No funds are ever stuck.

items.q: How do I verify a bet was fair?
items.a: Every settled round exposes its bet ID, VRF request ID, random hash, and settlement transaction. Use "Copy proof of fairness" on the result screen to export a JSON receipt anyone can independently verify on-chain.
Two things: the game's house edge (built into the odds) and a small Chainlink VRF fee in native gas to fund the randomness request. Both are shown before you confirm.

MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Trust, Rainbow, OKX, and any WalletConnect-compatible wallet. On desktop use a browser extension; on mobile, open the site inside your wallet's in-app browser or scan the WalletConnect QR.

items.q: Is this custodial? Do you hold my funds?
items.a: No. ArbiGameFi is non-custodial. Your funds stay in your wallet until you place a bet, and winnings settle directly back to your wallet. We never hold balances.

items.q: How do I stay in control of my play?
items.a: Open Responsible Gambling from the footer to set a session reminder, record daily deposit and loss limits, or self-exclude for a fixed period. These settings are saved in this browser only. Daily limits are not yet checked when you bet or deposit, and self-exclusion does not apply to other browsers, devices or apps. You must be of legal age in your jurisdiction to play.
